cases.name: err_forced_suppressed
cases.message: Every token in `forced_eos_token_id` ([2, 3]) is also in `suppress_tokens`. Forcing a token while suppressing it sets all logits to `-inf` at the forcing step, which produces `nan` probabilities and crashes generation. Remove the overlapping token(s) from either `forced_eos_token_id` or `suppress_tokens` (if you meant to prevent an early EOS token, use `min_new_tokens` instead).
